answer.summary: Two ArchUnit rules fail deterministically on this branch. AssetService.bulkUpdateAssets now injects TagRepository and calls findAllByIdInTenant, and the linked-id baseline expects a different resolution pattern at an AssetRepository site. Both failures are tied to the touched files and will repeat on re-run. The other log errors (Jackson parse, TenantScopedTransaction) look unrelated.
